_about: Every reusable number or factual claim, with who it belongs to, who approved it, and when it was last reviewed. Only claims with status 'approved' may appear in generated copy or graphics. Repeating a number on the website does not make it approved. If a claim you want is not here, do not use it.

status_values.approved: Use as written. Keep the attribution.
status_values.retired: Do not use. Kept here so it is not reintroduced.

attribution_rule: Easy Pay Direct track record is not EPD Commerce results. Easy Pay Direct claims must be attributed to Easy Pay Direct (for example 'Powered by Easy Pay Direct' or 'on Easy Pay Direct rails'). Never present them as EPD Commerce outcomes.
